slice: A7-4 restart effect observation, sealing and Lease cleanup confirmation
author: Claude Code (Opus 5.5)

decision.method: llm-council (5 advisors, 5 anonymous peer reviews, chairman)
decision.rejected: hybrid reader (Prometheus range query + single K8s read): copying one snapshot across the window fabricates evidence; query_range steps are lookback-filled and pass the 45s gap check falsely; HTTP contract and alert evaluation state cannot be reconstructed; 15s is a per-read limit, not a whole-verdict limit
decision.adopted: bounded in-run observation -> sealed batch -> WF09 reads sealed bytes only
adjustments: window start = applied_at + probe_window allowance (Pod never Ready => unresolved, not merely unknown)
sealed batch stored like A7-3a evidence (0700/0600, ledger keeps hash only)

identities.reader: GET deployments/lab-api, pods list, pods/proxy GET :8000/readyz and /items only (pods/proxy is a new RBAC need at wiring)

contract_change.EffectBatch.provenance: synthetic|captured (captured requires run_id, collector and per-sample source_sha256; synthetic forbids them)
contract_change.verify_effect: report provenance follows batch; judgement rules unchanged

mutations: terminating pods excluded from pod set
mutation_checks.note: run on a scratch copy; one copy-path fixture error is baseline and excluded

not_in_scope: process wiring (observation start, receipt/policy build, seal hash in ledger, Slack result)
concrete PromQL and alert rules pinned against platform Prometheus
no_external_actions: no cluster, deploy, Slack, incident drill, Terraform, paid model call
